title: Java Full Stack Developer: 3 to 4 Years Experience
description: One ordered path for an experienced candidate: refresh the basics, go deep on what interviews test, then add cloud and AI.

stages.description: Refresh: test yourself and skim what you already know

stages.title: Spring Boot, data and security
stages.description: Deep: internals, transactions, JPA, security and testing

stages.title: Databases and Redis
stages.description: Deep: indexes, query plans, isolation and caching

stages.title: Microservices and Kafka
stages.description: Deep: failure handling and delivery guarantees

topic.title: WebFlux, Spring Batch, GraphQL and load testing

stages.title: System design
stages.description: Deep: high-level and low-level design, on paper with a timer

topic.title: DDD, hexagonal architecture and technical debt

stages.title: Cloud and DevOps: AWS, Docker, CI/CD

topic.title: AWS core services for Java developers
A Spring Boot app on AWS

stages.title: Frontend: JavaScript, TypeScript and React
stages.description: Working level: own a feature end to end

topic.title: React with a Spring Boot API

stages.title: AI engineering for Java developers

topic.title: LLMs from Spring Boot with Spring AI

stages.title: DSA Patterns
stages.description: Ongoing: run this daily alongside the other stages, 2 problems a day

stages.title: The experienced interview
